criteria.description: The Python reference and the Java encoder write each status row as core does (sanitize, sorted-key json.dumps with ', '/': ', ASCII escapes, Python float repr, one LF).
criteria.evidence: Python: tests/test_status_log.py 47 pass; conformance test_status_append.py 25 fixtures pass. Java: StatusRowEncoderTest 10, StatusAppendFixtureTest 26 (20 valid byte-exact, 5 invalid, corpus floor), StatusRowSanitizerTest 7; WriteIntegrationTest.escapingSessionTimesNumbersAndNestedIdentityFieldsAreByteExact.
criteria.notes: Encoder asserts sorted code-point keys, ', '/': ' separators, ASCII escapes, Python float repr, one LF. generate_status_append.py --check against the core pin: exit 0.

criteria.description: The sanitizer matches core's sanitize_event_for_log: PII keys stripped at every depth, top-level session pair folded into a truncated session_duration_s.
criteria.evidence: StatusRowSanitizerTest (7 pass): stripsEveryPiiKeyAtEveryDepth, bothParseableTimesReplaceAndOverwriteDuration (negative truncation), missingMalformedOrNonStringTimesLeaveAnExistingDurationUntouched, nestedSessionKeysAreNotSessionFields; Python tests/test_status_log.py (47 pass); session_* status_append fixtures.
criteria.notes: Covers PII at every depth incl. lists, session pair fold, nested keys untouched. Core-generated oracle drift check exit 0.

criteria.description: The status_append family ships with >= 12 valid and >= 4 invalid cases; both bindings pass all; the generator's --check against core at the pin exits 0 locally and in CI.
criteria.evidence: Fixtures: 20 valid + 5 invalid (>=12/>=4). Python test_status_append.py 25 pass (+ README class-coverage test); Java StatusAppendFixtureTest 26 pass. generate_status_append.py --check at the pin (core-pin venv): exit 0. CI job write-core-parity in service.yml runs the same --check.
criteria.notes: Local --check exit 0 verified here. The CI leg exists (service.yml write-core-parity) and was not run here.

criteria.description: An accepted unit or batch is one O_APPEND write plus a sync (and a parent-directory sync on create) before 201; refused or fully replayed requests write and sync nothing.
criteria.evidence: StatusLogSessionTest (4): appendsEveryByteInOneCallThenForcesTheFile [open,size,write,force,close], syncingANewFile...ParentDirectory; JdkFileOps opens with APPEND. WriteServiceTest (14): aBatchUsesOneAppendAndAnAllReplayedBatchUsesNone, authorityAndPersistenceFailuresNeverAcknowledge; WriteIntegrationTest (24) us1-2, us3-1 (fsync 1 then 0).
criteria.notes: Refused and replayed requests: appendCalls == 0 asserted in WriteServiceTest; bytes unchanged asserted over HTTP in WriteIntegrationTest.

criteria.description: Every write holds <gcd>/spec-kitty-locks/<dir>.status.lock with core's lock semantics; a lock held past the 10 s budget answers 409 STATUS_LOCK_HELD.
criteria.evidence: MissionLockPathTest 8; StatusLogAppenderTest 9 (timesOutAgainstAnotherHolder..., release on throw); StatusLogInteropTest run with SPEC_KITTY_LOCK_INTEROP_PYTHON=core-pin venv: 1 pass (3 core Python writers + Java, 400 rows intact, java_contended 5); WriteServiceTest ...LockTimeouts (STATUS_LOCK_HELD); WriteIntegrationTest us1-5.
criteria.notes: Interop test is env-gated (skipped in the default run); I ran it against core at the pin. 409 mapping pinned by DomainValuesTest and OperationsTest all-code schema check. Windows channel-lock leg runs only in the CI matrix.

criteria.description: The open/flock/close downcalls are registered for the native image and the native smoke performs a real locked write.
criteria.evidence: NativeDowncallMetadataTest 1 pass (reachability-metadata.json: open/flock/close descriptors, variadic, captureCallState); command-cli build.gradle.kts buildArgs --enable-native-access=ALL-UNNAMED; NativeSmokeTest source asserts a real 201 write, byte-exact log and the .git/spec-kitty-locks/m.status.lock file; CI native-command-cli runs nativeCompile, nativeTest, nativeSmoke.
criteria.notes: The native leg is verified in CI. native-image is not installed locally, so NativeSmokeTest (@Tag native-binary) did not run here. Passed on the local evidence: metadata, drift test, build args, smoke source, CI wiring.

criteria.description: A torn tail or unreducible log is refused with 500 STATUS_EVENT_PERSISTENCE_VERIFICATION_FAILED and the file is unchanged.
criteria.evidence: StatusLogAppenderTest.refusesATornTailOnReadAndAppendWithoutRepairingIt (9 pass); WriteServiceTest.tornOrUnreducibleLogsAndLockTimeoutsAreNotWritten (appendCalls 0); WriteIntegrationTest.us1ScenarioSixATornTailIsRefusedUnchanged (500, bytes equal), interiorLogLinesFollowTheFold...; corpus fold-torn-tail and fold-invalid-json; WriteFoldTest 18.
criteria.notes: Torn tail and unreducible-log paths both asserted file-unchanged.

criteria.description: event_id idempotency: identical retry is replayed (appendedLines 0), partial or differing ids are EVENT_ID_CONFLICT, a repeated id in a request is BOOKKEEPING_DOUBLE_EVENT_ID, first occurrence wins.
criteria.evidence: ReplayClassifierTest 3 (first duplicate wins; partial and replay-after-new are conflicts); WriteIntegrationTest us1-2 (replayed true, appendedLines 0, bytes unchanged), us1-3 (EVENT_ID_CONFLICT), us1-4 (BOOKKEEPING_DOUBLE_EVENT_ID), aCrLfLogReplays...; ProtocolCorpusTest 34 incl. 6 replay-* cases over HTTP.
criteria.notes: Byte-equality replay incl. trailing CR in log. Replay classification precedes authority (decision 1), pinned by replay-stale-from-is-still-replay.

criteria.description: Write location verified against the service's own resolution; mismatches, bare repositories, lane worktrees and coordination_ref_commit answer 422 WRITE_LOCATION_UNVERIFIED.
criteria.evidence: RootCheckoutTest 10 (git rev-parse: bare, sparse-checkout bare, config.worktree, linked-worktree gitdir, missing/hung git fail closed; agrees with installed git); FilesystemMissionCatalogTest 6 (checkout 'lane', destinationRef, wrong dir, symlink escape); WriteIntegrationTest us4 x3 (422, tree hash unchanged; coordination_ref_commit detail names migration step 4).
criteria.notes: Decision 21 (R31): root checkout verified by asking git; GitConfig port deleted. R16 coordination-routed Mission refused 422 before any lock. Decisions 18-21 are the deliberate divergences from core on this criterion.

criteria.description: No class outside the three allowlisted packages calls a JDK open-for-write API, enforced by ArchUnit with one shared predicate list and planted violations.
criteria.evidence: command-cli WriteOwnershipRulesTest 2 (planted RogueWriter fires, ConformingReader holds); event-log EventLogBoundaryTest 15 (WRITE_OWNERSHIP, ONLY_THE_FOUR_PACKAGES, planted FilesWriteOutsideStatusLog and ChannelOpenOutsideStatusLog); shared predicate testFixtures FileWriteApis; root ArchitectureRulesTest 17 (rule 7 incl. statuslog package).
criteria.notes: Root :mission-status-api:test (1980 tests, 0 failures) ran inside scripts/verify_all.sh.

criteria.description: The lane machine (11 lanes, 29 edges, terminals, force semantics) and the write fold are ported from core at the pin, separate from StatusReducer.
criteria.evidence: LaneMachineTest 4 (exactly 29 edges, every other pair illegal, terminals have no targets, genesis illegal under force, force reaches any other target incl. same lane and uninitialized); WriteFoldTest 18 (separate WriteFold); ParityCorpusTest 239; StatusReducerTest 30 pass (no service/src/main diff, read side untouched).
criteria.notes: Uses domain-model Lane. Parity generator --check against the core pin: exit 0 (196 core cases, drift 0).

criteria.description: Every guard refusal carries the contract code and reason URN core raises; each of the 15 reasons is reached by a parity case or recorded unreachable with its cause.
criteria.evidence: ProtocolCorpusTest 34 (everyGuardReasonOverHttp: 15 reasons reached; workspace_context_required recorded unreachable); ReasonLedgerTest 1 (all 16 RefusalReason entries have a corpus case or a non-blank unreachable cause); Python test_every_reason_is_reached_or_has_an_unreachable_cause and test_refusal_vocabulary_is_closed (16 URNs); ParityCorpusTest 239 compares code, reason and unit.
criteria.notes: Decision 17: the vocabulary is 16 (stale_from_lane added), not FR-012's 15; judged against 16. unreachable.json holds the cause and a 'partial' cause for implementation_evidence_required.

criteria.description: Dependency gating on planned->claimed and claimed->in_progress follows core's verdict (approved, done, operator-canceled; unresolvable is unsatisfied; force bypasses).
criteria.evidence: DependencyVerdictTest 4; ParityCorpusTest 239 incl. dependency-* cases (approved/done/operator-canceled accepted; synthetic-cancel, missing, ambiguous, malformed, unreadable unsatisfied; dependency-force-bypass); DiskMissionFactsTest 31; DiskMissionFactsParityTest 239; WriteIntegrationTest us2-2.

criteria.description: The write domain is framework-free, I/O-free and concurrency-free, enforced by an ArchUnit rule with planted violations.

criteria.notes: Rule also bans clocks, stricter than the spec.
